description: This file defines the CityFinder class, which provides static methods to set latitude and longitude values and to retrieve the city name based on geographic coordinates using Android's Geocoder API.

classes.name: CityFinder
classes.description: A utility class for handling city-related location operations, including setting coordinates and retrieving city names.

methods.name: setLongitudeLatitude
methods.description: Sets the latitude and longitude in the LocationCord class based on the provided Location object.

methods.name: getCityNameUsingNetwork
methods.description: Retrieves the city name for the given location using Android's Geocoder API.
